notes.name: Foundry MCP Server v0.8.5
notes.body:
## Foundry MCP Server v0.8.5

Complete multi-platform distribution for Foundry MCP Server - AI-powered campaign management for Foundry VTT using Claude Desktop.

**Compatible with Foundry VTT v13 and v14.**

### Installation Options

**Windows Users:**
- Download `FoundryMCPServer-Setup-v0.8.5.exe`
- Run installer (no admin rights required)
- Automatic Claude Desktop configuration

**Mac Users:**
- Download `FoundryMCPServer-v0.8.5.dmg`
- Open DMG and double-click the PKG installer
- Choose components: MCP Server (required), Foundry Module, ComfyUI AI Maps
- Automatic Claude Desktop configuration
- To uninstall: Double-click `Uninstall.tool` from the DMG

**Manual Installation (All Platforms):**
- Download `foundry-mcp-server-v0.8.5.zip`
- Extract and run with Node.js 18+
- Manual Claude Desktop configuration required

**Foundry VTT Users:**
- Install directly from Foundry's module browser
- Or use manifest: `https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/releases/latest/download/module.json`

### Quick Start
1. Choose your installation method above
2. Install MCP Bridge module in Foundry VTT
3. Restart Claude Desktop
4. Start creating AI-powered campaigns!

### New in this release
- Security fix: bridge queries are now only accepted from GM users. Updating is recommended.
- `manage-world-items` can read a world item in full: description, system data and rules
- `get-character` can read an unlinked token's own stats and effects by token ID or UUID
- PF2e: languages in `get-character`, and rule elements and effect changes now include their `key`
- dnd5e: Activity save configuration and Advancement data are no longer dropped from detailed item reads
- Clearer Claude Desktop config instructions for manual installs

See the changelog for the full list.

### Features
- 48 MCP tools for comprehensive Foundry VTT integration
- Multi-system support: D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, DSA5, Cosmere RPG, WFRP4e, and Mongoose Traveller 2e
- Generic actor CRUD (create/update/delete actors and embedded items) across all systems
- D&D 5e NPC creation suite: stat blocks, attacks, saves, auras, and spellcasting
- Actor creation with natural language processing
- Quest management with HTML generation and updates
- Campaign system with multi-part structure and progress tracking
- Dice roll coordination between Claude and Foundry players
- Actor ownership management with bulk operations
- Enhanced creature index for instant monster searches
- AI-powered battlemap generation with ComfyUI integration

For full documentation, visit: https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp


## What's Changed
* fix: preserve dnd5e Advancement and Activity save serialization by @LordSkull in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/110
* fix: resolve synthetic token actors in get-character by @LordSkull in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/111
* docs(get-character): mention token ID and UUID lookup in the tool description by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/113
* feat(pf2e): include languages in get-character stats by @tacostorm in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/112
* feat(world-items): read a world item in full, and stop stripping rule element keys by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/119
* docs: fix the Claude Desktop config instructions for manual installs by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/120
* fix(security): check the calling user on bridge query handlers by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/121
* chore(release): prepare v0.8.5 by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/122


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5

- DSA5 system support, plus a new `replace-journal-page` tool
- `manage-actors` can now place existing world actors onto the current scene
- Fixes: `use-item` targeting on Foundry V13/V14, Windows installer upgrade safety (no longer risks an existing ComfyUI install), large responses timing out over WebRTC, and several D&D 5e feature-creation defects

See the changelog for the full list.

### Features
- 48 MCP tools for comprehensive Foundry VTT integration
- Multi-system support: D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, DSA5, Cosmere RPG, WFRP4e, and Mongoose Traveller 2e
- Generic actor CRUD (create/update/delete actors and embedded items) across all systems
- D&D 5e NPC creation suite: stat blocks, attacks, saves, auras, and spellcasting
- Actor creation with natural language processing
- Quest management with HTML generation and updates
- Campaign system with multi-part structure and progress tracking
- Dice roll coordination between Claude and Foundry players
- Actor ownership management with bulk operations
- Enhanced creature index for instant monster searches
- AI-powered battlemap generation with ComfyUI integration

For full documentation, visit: https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp

* feat: DSA5 adapter support (normalizePayload, describeActorSchema) + system detection + replace-journal-page tool by @frankyh75 in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/81
* fix: include scene_name in map job dedup hash (#80) by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/84
* fix: register getPackIndex query for list-dsa5-archetypes (#77) by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/83
* feat: add 'place' action to manage-actors for existing world actors (#75) by @adambdooley in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/85
* fix: scope .form-footer rules to the module's own settings forms by @apoapostolov in https://github.com/adambdooley/foundry-vtt-mcp/pull/97

digest.note: Release notes say only that a deprecation was fixed. No API, hook, or flag is named, so the affected code path is unknown.

areas.what_breaks: Nothing expected. The patch only removes a deprecated call. Our bar composition, pip getters, special-action wraps and Reaction slot rely on Argon's panel/button internals (_buttons, label, maxActions, _onLeftClick, _isWeaponSet), and a deprecation fix is unlikely to touch these.

Nothing expected. The Rituals and Longer casts groups wrap ButtonPanelButton#_renderInner and read _spells, _parent and showPreparedOnly. The item-button targets and getTooltipData wraps are resolved lazily and guarded.

Nothing expected. Wild Shape and Starry Form subclass CONFIG.ARGON.MAIN.BUTTONS classes and recompose bars by panel label. If the fixed deprecation is the checkBonus shim our registry mentions, that only removes a warning.

Nothing in the note touches panels or render hooks.

still_needed.native_now: nothing; Argon still counts one pip per Action
still_needed.why: Per-instance getter override falls back to the prototype getter; guarded by protoDescriptor.

No change to spell bar filing.
MovementHud.updateMovement call is guarded by a typeof check.
